title: Gemini-CLI Sovereign Memory Architecture
description: Defines the forensic storage hierarchy for the CLI substrate, enforcing the 'Link-not-Load' principle and topographic isolation.

values.name: Clinical Nucleus (Restored)
values.rule: Maintain a strict bifurcation between the perennial DNA (json/heartwood/) and procedural RNA (json/wedo/).
values.rationale: Ensures that core legislative intent outlasts ephemeral session performance.

values.name: Isolated Chrono-Fractal
values.rule: Every technical strike within the CLI MUST be forensically anchored in a date-based directory hierarchy (YYYY/QX/MM/DD).
values.rationale: Prevents context bloom and enables surgical discovery of historical performance.

values.name: Visibility Standard
values.rule: Renaming to '_public' signifies a commitment to open forensic attribution. All memory nodes must be bit-perfectly valid JSON.
values.rationale: Acknowledges the repository's identity as a shared living organism.
